Recall: The fraction of relevant instances that are retrieved, i.e., the number of true positives (TP) over the sum of true positives and false negatives (TP + FN).

ROC-AUC: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, which represents the trade-off between true positive rate (TPR) and false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. It is calculated by integrating the TPR over all possible FPR values.
